#1339 authoring exemption — DISABLE it so every PR naming a queued brief represents it first-wins, as before the fix: a MERGED docs-only PR that only AUTHORED the brief makes it read as landed-unreconciled again. TestPlan_AuthoringPRDoesNotLandBrief must go red (the brief is listed under LANDED-UNRECONCILED instead of offered for dispatch).
